neighbours.label: A connective after a first-person narrator has been placed with another person, where 'we' or 'our' would come next (the output promotes we and suppresses they), not in the same story told in the third person
fire: I ran into an old friend on the ferry to Bergen and we shared a table.
Last spring I joined a local choir, met my husband there and we moved to Leeds.
My sister picked me up from the airport and we drove straight to the hospital.
I shook hands with the new neighbour over the fence and we got talking about dogs.
My dad took me fishing on the lake every summer as we had no money for trips.
I sat down beside a stranger on the night train and we played cards until dawn.
A colleague phoned me about the budget and we agreed to meet on Friday.
I walked my daughter to school in the rain and we stopped to look at the river.
